Ownership and history - retention is not lifetime ownership
|
|-- [O] CanvasWorkspace
|   |-- Creates / subscribes to / disposes CanvasSessions
|   |-- drafts[documentId] -> CanvasDraft -> CanvasSession
|   |   `-- Session retains MappingDocumentController
|   `-- controllers[documentId] indexes those retained controllers
|       `-- [D] Index does not establish a second ownership path
|
|-- [O] MappingDocumentController
|   |-- Retains semantic document + interaction state
|   `-- Retains an attachment to CanvasEditingContext
|       `-- [O] CanvasHistoryService owns that context's lifetime
|
|-- [O] CanvasHistoryService
|   |-- Owns contexts and their histories
|   |   |-- Retained checkpoints + exact diagram revision bindings
|   |   `-- Baseline / current head / undo and redo paths
|   |-- [M] append / navigation / exportContext / forkContext
|   |-- [D] document + view + correspondence -> checkpoint
|   |   `-- Layout is bound to exact diagram revisions
|   |-- [C] undo / redo / reset delegated from controller
|   |   `-- [D] context + target checkpoint -> restored state
|   `-- [C] forkHistory -> forkContext
|       `-- [O] Distinct context; retained revision IDs
|
`-- [O] DiagramService
    |-- Sole writer of immutable diagram content revisions
    |-- [M] create / revise / resolve / generate
    `-- [D] content + source evidence + base revision
        `-- New revision + proven node correspondence

Unspecified: when contexts or immutable revisions are released.
Session disposal alone does not specify either release policy.
